product_launches.description: Mariana Minerals launched its MarianaOS autonomy-first mining operating system into full production at the Copper One mine and refinery in Utah, coordinating autonomous haulage, drilling, sensing, refining and capital project execution across MineOS, PlantOS, and CapitalProjectOS subsystems.

overview_description.description: Mariana Minerals is a vertically integrated minerals company that develops and operates mineral projects focused on supplying critical minerals. The company combines mining operations with software and technology systems to improve mineral exploration, project development, processing, and operational efficiency. Its activities include the development of lithium, copper, nickel, and other mineral resources used in energy, AI, and defense-related applications.

product.name: Mineral Project Development and Operations
product.description: Vertically integrated development and operation of minerals projects, covering resource acquisition or partnerships, engineering, construction, commissioning, and ongoing operations.

product.name: MarianaOS
product.description: An in-house software and artificial intelligence platform for executing mineral capital projects and optimizing mining and refining operations.

product.name: Critical Minerals Production
product.description: Development and production of minerals used in energy, artificial intelligence, and defense applications, with current project development focused on lithium, copper, and nickel.

product.name: Copper
product.description: Copper production from mineral projects developed and operated by Mariana Minerals for applications including electrification, energy infrastructure, AI infrastructure, and defense.

product.name: Lithium
product.description: Lithium production from mineral projects developed and operated by Mariana Minerals, primarily for energy-storage and electrification applications.

product.name: Nickel
product.description: Nickel production from mineral projects developed and operated by Mariana Minerals for energy, industrial, and defense-related supply chains.
